notes: UNV has implicit {<WH03974>} after 大的/小的; LCC makes this explicit with 發光體, so the braces were dropped and <WH03974> attached to 發光體.
The direct-object marker {<WAH0853>} remains implicit in LCC, so it is kept braced before each corresponding object phrase.
LCC's final 又造 has no separate Hebrew verb equivalent here; only {<WAH0853>}星辰<WH03556> is tagged in that closing segment.
